analysis.one_line_summary: Static studio ad featuring a smiling model holding up the pink WavyTalk Blowout Boost thermal brush with an iOS reminder notification overlay.
analysis.full_description: A vertical static creative set against a vibrant purple studio background with overhead lens flares. A brunette model in a black strapless top smiles softly in the background while extending the light pink WavyTalk Blowout Boost thermal brush toward the camera in sharp focus. An Apple-style popup reminder card is positioned at the lower center, reading 'Reminder: This is your sign to upgrade your hair routine!' with two pink action buttons: 'Let's do it!' and 'I'm on it!'.

on_screen_text.text:
Reminder
This is your sign to upgrade your hair routine!
Let's do it! | I'm on it!
